reviewer_scope: R3-6: resource-matched comparison and latency-scope clarification
R5-7: practical applicability and whether performance gains justify computational cost
R4-09: intended deployment context and efficiency implications
W3/W12 linkage: attach cost to all defensible ablation configurations

authoritative_efficiency_sources.primary_scope: model computation on prepared device tensors; disk I/O, image decoding, preprocessing, and host-device transfer excluded
authoritative_efficiency_sources.supplemental_legacy_source: Phase16_5A locked A100 benchmark, used only for MAC accounting, ScNet, standalone fusion timing, and optional batch-8 context
authoritative_efficiency_sources.batch8_rule: Phase18C did not directly measure batch 8. Batch-8 values may be shown only as supplemental Phase16_5A measurements, never relabelled as Phase18C.

cost_composition_rules.parameters: Exact additive count across instantiated checkpoints; temperature contributes one scalar parameter.
cost_composition_rules.MACs: Exact additive under the locked Phase16_5A convention: Conv/Linear MACs plus explicit DINO qk/av attention; excluded normalization, activation, pooling, softmax, concatenation, and temperature arithmetic.
cost_composition_rules.checkpoint_storage: Exact additive from frozen checkpoint file bytes. For residual deployment use the directly audited full package size.
cost_composition_rules.latency_direct: Use Phase18C direct medians for 1C, 1D, 5C, 5D, and the full 5C+5D residual system.
cost_composition_rules.latency_composed: For unmeasured n=2..4 same-family and 1C+1D/simple combinations, estimate sequential batch latency by summing directly measured single-model medians. For 5C+5D simple averaging, use direct 5C plus direct 5D latency. Mark every such value ESTIMATED, not measured.
cost_composition_rules.fusion_latency: For OOF residual-fusion cost and composition validation only, use the locked Phase16_5A standalone fusion timing; three seed passes are summed. The phase/source distinction must be explicit.
cost_composition_rules.peak_memory: Do NOT add or estimate peak CUDA memory for unmeasured combinations. Report peak allocated/reserved memory only for directly profiled 1C, 1D, 5C, 5D, and full systems.
cost_composition_rules.throughput: Use direct Phase18C throughput only for directly measured systems. For composed latency rows, an estimated sequential throughput may be derived as batch_size*1000/latency_ms and labelled ESTIMATED.

validation_acceptance_rule: Composed latency may be used descriptively if direct-vs-composed validation error remains within ±5% on the audited representative configurations; otherwise no composed latency is reported.

OOF.cost_semantics: single-pair inference cost, not 5+5 deployment cost
OOF.note: M1 nested estimate is a selection-sensitivity reference, not a separate deployment configuration and is not placed on the Pareto frontier.

fixed_HAM.systems: ConvNeXt n=1..5 means; DINO n=1..5 means; mean 1C+1D; 5C+5D simple average; frozen deployment

Derm7pt.evidence_role: post-reveal descriptive scoring of pre-reveal frozen branch predictions
Derm7pt.systems: ConvNeXt n=1..5 means; DINO n=1..5 means; mean 1C+1D; 5C+5D simple average; frozen deployment

BCN20000.systems: ConvNeXt n=1..5 means; DINO n=1..5 means; mean 1C+1D; 5C+5D simple average; frozen deployment

pareto_definition.x_axis_primary: aggregate MACs per image, log scale
pareto_definition.efficient_point: No other plotted configuration has both <= MACs and >= macro-F1, with at least one strict inequality.
secondary_cost_tables: peak CUDA allocated memory where directly measured
pareto_definition.dominated_points: Never omit a valid configuration merely because it is dominated.

ScNet_rule.internal: Include the protocol-matched ScNet OOF point from the locked Phase16_5A benchmark.
ScNet_rule.external: Leave explicit placeholder 'external ScNet pending W4'; do not fabricate or extrapolate an external point.

deployment_context.timing_limit: Reported timing is model execution only on prepared GPU tensors.

integrity_rules: No training, inference, model adaptation, recalibration, threshold change, or performance recomputation from labels for W12.
W12 joins frozen W3 performance values to locked compute measurements only.
Direct measurement and composed estimates must be visually and textually distinguishable.
Do not select a precision mode or batch size after seeing performance; CUDA AMP is the primary locked comparison mode.
No title/model change is triggered by W12; W12 informs Discussion and reviewer responses.
